title.narrative: Support to Media and Media Productions in Serbia

description.narrative: The overall objective of this action is strengthening media pluralism, contributing to protection and promotion of democracy in Serbia. The specific objective of this grant is to sustain and strengthen contribution of supported media to increasing access to information and countering disinformation, reaching the youth and (other) vulnerable audiences in Serbia, in particular in light of the challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic.
